rows.text: Rights Issue Committee fixes terms of its already-approved (14-Aug) rights issue: 1,63,83,358 shares at Rs 30 (incl Rs 20 premium), 1-for-1, Rs 49.15 cr, opens 2-Dec.
cancels a scheduled Rights Issue Committee meeting; no new date given, no raise currently in progress.
receives **in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for a rights issue of fully paid-up shares**; size, price and record date are not yet disclosed.
approves a **rights issue of up to Rs 49.75 crore**, more than **seven-tenths of its own market value**, with the record date still to be notified
